units: <cite ref="Yevamot 75b:1">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> top <he>חַרְזֵיה סילוא וכ׳</he> a thorn wounded him &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:13">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>זיבורא ודחרזיה וכ׳</he> he who suffers from the sting of a wasp, or of a thorn.

senses.gloss: to string beads; trnsf. to compare verses (v. preced.).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10">Cant. R. to I, 10</cite> <he>אית דידע למֶיחֲרוֹז וכ׳</he> some know how to string but not how to bore pearls, i.e. some know how to bring on parallels without having the ability to enter into the depth of a subject.
